section.content: 一种锂离子电池，包括：壳体，壳体内设有电极组件和电解液；顶盖组件，顶盖组件盖设于壳体的开口端；转接构件，转接构件设于顶盖组件的下方，用于连接顶盖组件和电极组件，转接构件包括平板部，平板部上设有朝顶盖组件凸出的凸包；焊渣防护胶，焊渣防护胶包括封堵部和防护帽，封堵部从下方插设于凸包内，防护帽与平板部的下表面相连接。焊渣防护胶的设计可以阻止转接构件在焊接于顶盖组件的过程中产生的金属颗粒物掉落电极组件中，有效解决了现有技术中由于在焊接过程中产生的金属颗粒物而引起的电极组件短路或自放电加剧的问题。

A lithium ion battery comprising: a case in which an electrode assembly and an electrolyte are disposed; the top cover component is arranged at the opening end of the shell in a covering manner; the adapter component is arranged below the top cover component and used for connecting the top cover component and the electrode component, and comprises a flat plate part, and a convex hull protruding towards the top cover component is arranged on the flat plate part; the welding slag protective glue comprises a blocking part and a protective cap, wherein the blocking part is inserted into the convex hull from the lower part, and the protective cap is connected with the lower surface of the flat plate part. The design of welding slag protective glue can prevent metal particles generated in the process of welding the adapter component to the top cover component from falling into the electrode component, and effectively solves the problem of short circuit or self-discharge aggravation of the electrode component caused by the metal particles generated in the welding process in the prior art.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the power battery field, more specifically relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

A lithium ion battery generally includes an electrode assembly, a case and cap assembly, and an adapter member assembled in the case. The top cover assembly comprises a top cover plate and positive and negative poles, the top cover assembly is covered at the opening end of the shell and is connected with the shell in a welding mode, and the electrode assembly is connected with the top cover assembly through a switching component.

In the prior art, in order to form a closed circuit by positive and negative poles of an electrode assembly and a top cover assembly, a switching member is generally used for connecting the electrode assembly and the positive and negative poles, the connection mode mainly adopts laser welding or ultrasonic welding at present, both the ultrasonic welding and the laser welding can generate metal particles in the welding process, and if the metal particles fall into the electrode assembly in the production and use processes, the problem of short circuit or self-discharge aggravation of the electrode assembly can be caused.

Therefore, it is desirable to invent a lithium ion battery capable of effectively solving the problem of short circuit or self-discharge aggravation of an electrode assembly due to metal particles generated during welding.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at providing a lithium ion battery to solve among the prior art because the metal particles thing that produces in welding process and the problem that the electrode subassembly short circuit or self discharge aggravation arouse.

In order to achieve the above object, the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, including:

a case in which an electrode assembly and an electrolyte are disposed;

the top cover component is arranged at the opening end of the shell in a covering manner;

the adapter component is arranged below the top cover component and used for connecting the top cover component and the electrode component, and comprises a flat plate part, and a convex hull protruding towards the top cover component is arranged on the flat plate part;

the welding slag protective glue comprises a blocking portion and a protective cap, the blocking portion is inserted into the convex hull from the lower side, and the protective cap is connected with the lower surface of the flat plate portion.

Optionally, the opposite sides of the adapter member are further respectively provided with a step structure, and the convex hull is disposed on the flat plate portion and close to the step structure.

Optionally, the convex hull is circular.

Optionally, the blocking portion is cylindrical, the protective cap is connected to one end of the blocking portion, and the protective cap has a spherical surface.

Optionally, the welding slag protective glue is made of conductive glue.

Optionally, a predetermined gap is provided between the protective cap and the electrode assembly.

Optionally, the blocking portion is bonded to the convex hull.

Optionally, an electrode current collector is further included;

the electrode current collector is of a U-shaped structure, one side of the U-shaped structure is connected with the electrode assembly, and the other side of the U-shaped structure is connected with the switching component.

Optionally, the device further comprises a top cover plastic part;

the top cover plastic part is pressed between the top cover assembly and the switching component.

Optionally, the top cap assembly comprises a top cap plate and a pair of poles;

the convex hull of the switching component is connected with the pole through welding.

The beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that:

the switching component is arranged below the top cover assembly and comprises a flat plate part, a convex hull protruding towards the top cover assembly is arranged on the flat plate part, the welding slag protective glue comprises a blocking part and a protective cap, the blocking part is inserted into the convex hull from the lower part, and the protective cap is connected with the lower surface of the flat plate part; the design of welding slag protective glue can prevent metal particles generated in the process of welding the adapter component to the top cover component from falling into the electrode component, and effectively solves the problem of short circuit or self-discharge aggravation of the electrode component caused by the metal particles generated in the welding process in the prior art.

Other features and advantages of the present invention will be described in detail in the detailed description which follows.

Drawings

The above and other objects, features and advantages of the present invention will become more apparent by describing in more detail exemplary embodiments thereof with reference to the attached drawings, in which like reference numerals generally represent like parts throughout the exemplary embodiments of the present invention.

Fig. 1 shows a schematic structural diagram of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention.

Fig. 2 shows a cross-sectional view of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the invention.

Fig. 3 shows a schematic structural diagram of an adapter member of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention.

Fig. 4 shows a schematic structural diagram of the welding slag protective adhesive of the lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention.

Description of the reference numerals

1. A housing; 2. an electrode assembly; 3. a top cover plate; 4. a pole column; 5. a changeover member; 51. a convex hull; 52. a flat plate portion; 53. a step structure; 6. a plugging section; 7. a protective cap; 8. a top cover plastic part; 9. and an electrode current collector.

Detailed Description

Preferred embodiments of the present invention will be described in more detail below. While the following describes preferred embodiments of the present invention, it should be understood that the present invention may be embodied in various forms and should not be construed as limited to the embodiments set forth herein. Rather, these embodiments are provided so that this disclosure will be thorough and complete, and will fully convey the scope of the invention to those skilled in the art.

According to the utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, include:

a case in which an electrode assembly and an electrolyte are disposed;

the top cover component is arranged at the opening end of the shell in a covering manner;

the adapter component is arranged below the top cover component and used for connecting the top cover component and the electrode component, and comprises a flat plate part, and a convex hull protruding towards the top cover component is arranged on the flat plate part;

the welding slag protective glue comprises a blocking part and a protective cap, wherein the blocking part is inserted into the convex hull from the lower part, and the protective cap is connected with the lower surface of the flat plate part.

Specifically, the switching component is arranged below the top cover assembly and comprises a flat plate part, a convex hull protruding towards the top cover assembly is arranged on the flat plate part, the welding slag protective glue comprises a blocking part and a protective cap, the blocking part is inserted into the convex hull from the lower part, and the protective cap is connected with the lower surface of the flat plate part; the design of welding slag protective glue can prevent metal particles generated in the process of welding the adapter component to the top cover component from falling into the electrode component, and effectively solves the problem of short circuit or self-discharge aggravation of the electrode component caused by the metal particles generated in the welding process in the prior art.

Further, positive and negative pole piece easily takes place the dislocation when electrode subassembly is convoluteed to easily produce the problem of dislocation undetected in dislocation testing process, if take place the dislocation undetected and will increase the risk of electrode short circuit or self-discharge aggravation, and the utility model provides a welding slag protective adhesive not only reduces the risk that metal particles dropped in the welding process among the electrode subassembly, also can in time discover the battery of positive and negative pole piece dislocation and in time remove it in the production manufacturing link in addition, has improved the security performance of battery with extremely low detection cost and safeguard means.

In one example, the opposite sides of the adapting member are respectively provided with a step structure, and the convex hulls are arranged on the flat plate part at positions close to the step structures.

In one example, the convex hull is circular.

Specifically, the adapter component includes a flat plate portion and a convex hull, and in practical processes, the convex hull is usually punched out of the flat plate portion by using a punching technology, a corresponding recess is formed on the inner side of the convex hull, and the blocking portion is inserted into the recess.

In one example, the blocking portion is cylindrical, and a protective cap is connected to one end of the blocking portion, the protective cap having a spherical surface;

the plugging part is bonded with the convex hull;

a predetermined gap is provided between the helmet and the electrode assembly.

Specifically, the blocking part is cylindrical, the blocking part is filled in the convex hull and is bonded with the convex hull, and the protective cap extends outwards of the flat plate part by taking the axial direction of the blocking part as the center to form a spherical surface.

Furthermore, a preset gap is formed between the protective cap and the electrode assembly, the possibility that the welding slag protective adhesive is soaked in electrolyte or electrolyte steam exists in the production and manufacturing process of the lithium ion battery, strong acid is generated due to electrolyte deformation, the shear strength of the welding slag protective adhesive is weakened due to the strong acid, the preset gap is required to be formed between the protective cap and the electrode assembly, the welding slag protective adhesive covers the flat plate portion of the switching component as much as possible in order to reduce hidden dangers caused by the electrolyte, and the welding slag protective adhesive is prevented from falling off from the switching component.

In one example, the material of the welding slag protective glue is conductive glue.

Specifically, the welding slag protective glue is made of conductive glue and can be formed by doping an insulating glue with a conductive agent, the glue body can be heated to a molten state firstly during glue dispensing, then the welding slag protective glue is dripped into a convex hull of the switching component through a glue gun until the glue amount is set, the surface is spherical, and after semi-cooling, the welding slag protective glue and a flat plate part of the switching component are tightly connected by slightly reshaping through a pressing plate.

In one example, an electrode current collector is further included;

the electrode current collector is of a U-shaped structure, one side of the U-shaped structure is connected with the electrode assembly, and the other side of the U-shaped structure is connected with the switching component.

In one example, the plastic part of the top cover is further included;

the top cover plastic part is pressed between the top cover assembly and the switching component.

Specifically, the free end of the top cap plastic part is further provided with a vertical structure perpendicular to the top cap plastic part, one surface of the vertical structure is engaged with the inner side wall of the shell, and the length of the vertical structure is preferably equal to the distance between the top cap assembly and the electrode assembly.

In one example, the top cap assembly includes a top cap plate and a pair of posts;

the convex hull of the switching component is connected with the pole through welding.

Examples

As shown in fig. 1-2, a lithium ion battery includes:

a case 1 in which an electrode assembly 2 and an electrolyte are disposed;

the top cover component is arranged at the opening end of the shell 1 in a covering manner;

the adapting component 5 is arranged below the top cover assembly and is used for connecting the top cover assembly and the electrode assembly 2, the adapting component 5 comprises a flat plate part 52, and a convex hull 51 protruding towards the top cover assembly is arranged on the flat plate part 52;

the welding slag protective glue comprises a blocking part 6 and a protective cap 7, wherein the blocking part 6 is inserted into the convex hull 51 from the lower part, and the protective cap 7 is connected with the lower surface of the flat plate part 52.

As shown in fig. 3, the opposite sides of the adapting member 5 are respectively provided with a step 53, and the convex hull 51 is disposed on the flat plate portion 52 near the step 53. As shown in fig. 4, the convex hull 51 is circular, the sealing part 6 is cylindrical, the protective cap 7 is connected to one end of the sealing part 6, the protective cap 7 has a spherical surface, the sealing part 6 is adhered to the convex hull 51, and a predetermined gap is provided between the protective cap 7 and the electrode assembly 2. The lithium ion battery also comprises an electrode current collector 9, wherein the electrode current collector 9 is of a U-shaped structure, one side of the U-shaped structure is connected with the electrode assembly 2, and the other side of the U-shaped structure is connected with the switching component 5; the lithium ion battery further comprises a top cover plastic part 8. The top cover plastic part 8 is pressed between the top cover assembly and the adapting component 5. The top cover assembly comprises a top cover plate 3 and a pair of poles 4, and the convex hulls 51 of the switching members 5 are connected with the poles 4 through welding.

In summary, the switching member is arranged below the top cover assembly and comprises a flat plate part, a convex hull protruding towards the top cover assembly is arranged on the flat plate part, the welding slag protective glue comprises a blocking part and a protective cap, the blocking part is inserted into the convex hull from the lower part, and the protective cap is connected with the lower surface of the flat plate part; the design of welding slag protective glue can prevent metal particles generated in the process of welding the adapter component to the top cover component from falling into the electrode component, and effectively solves the problem of short circuit or self-discharge aggravation of the electrode component caused by the metal particles generated in the welding process in the prior art.

While various embodiments of the present invention have been described above, the above description is intended to be illustrative, not exhaustive, and not limited to the disclosed embodiments. Many modifications and variations will be apparent to those of ordinary skill in the art without departing from the scope and spirit of the described embodiments.
